title: Exit Plan
content:
# Property Exit Strategy, Q1 Bridge Structure, & Tax-Refund Settlement Plan

**Landlord / Owner**  
**November 22, 2026**

---

## Executive Summary

Neither of us can sustain the current housing costs long-term, and operating without a firm, documented exit date is unfair to you. The purpose of this proposal is to establish a binding move-out timeline, immediately strip household operations down to bare essentials, and lock in full repayment of our $[redacted] balance (plus any agreed Q1 bridge support) out of our tax refund.

Two transition paths are detailed below. **Option B is strongly recommended** because it aligns directly with our late-February/early-March tax refund window—allowing us to repay you in a single lump sum, fund our next down payment (RV/5th wheel, mobile home, land, or rental/house), and execute an orderly, documented move without a mid-winter emergency scramble.

---

## Core Commitments (Effective Immediately Under Either Option)

- **Immediate "Bare-Minimum" Lifestyle Reset:** All non-essential belongings are being moved into storage, sold, or donated immediately. The house will be stripped down to basic living essentials only, keeping the property clean, uncluttered, and ready for final walkthrough. 100% of proceeds from sold household items go directly into our dedicated moving reserve or toward reducing the $[redacted] balance early.

- **Tax Refund Payoff Priority:** Our household tax return is filed early each year and typically deposits in late February / early March. **$[redacted]** from this refund is allocated to settling our balance with you in full, with the remaining balance dedicated exclusively to the down payment/move-in costs for our next housing arrangement.

- **24/7 Live Transparency Portal:** The portal features a live financial ledger, a checklist of monthly milestones, and a chronological photo feed documenting room clear-outs, storage loads, and item sales—plus comment/note fields so you can add input or verify progress directly.

---

## Option Comparison Overview

| | **Option A: Hard Exit (Dec 31, 2026)** | **Option B: Phased Checkpoint Exit (Mar 31, 2027)** |
|---|---|---|
| **Final Move-Out Date** | December 31, 2026 | March 31, 2027 (Hard Stop) |
| **Q1 2027 Financial Support** | $[redacted] (Ends December 31) | Up to $[redacted]/mo (Jan–Mar, only if monthly checkpoints pass) |
| **Repayment of $[redacted] Balance** | Paid in full upon Feb/Mar tax refund (or installments if delayed) | Paid in full (plus any Q1 bridge) upon Feb/Mar tax refund |
| **Next Housing Placement** | Unfinalized; forces temporary scramble before refund arrives | Researched & locked before refund (5th wheel, mobile home, land, or house) |
| **Accountability & Oversight** | Portal active through Dec 31 | Portal active with formal Dec 31, Jan 31, & Feb 28 Go/No-Go gates |
| **Overall Risk to Both Parties** | High (holiday rush, depleted cash reserves, temporary instability) | Low (structured wind-down backed by near-term lump-sum payoff) |

---

## Recommended Path: Option B — Phased Exit with Monthly Checkpoints (Through March 31, 2027)

### Financial Terms (Option B)

- **$[redacted]** accrued through December 31, 2026.
- **Up to $[redacted]/mo** (or bare-minimum utility/housing split of $[redacted]) for January, February, and March—strictly capped and contingent on passing each monthly checkpoint.
- Within **7 days** of our tax refund clearing (expected late February – early March 2027), we will pay the **full balance ($[redacted] + any Q1 bridge)** in full, leaving zero ongoing debt between us.
- All remaining tax refund funds go directly toward acquiring and moving into our next residence (5th wheel/camper, mobile home, land, or house—whichever option provides the cleanest, most affordable long-term fit).

### Mandatory Monthly Checkpoints (Go / No-Go Gates)

Progress will be documented with photos and ledger entries on the Transparency Portal prior to each checkpoint date:

**Checkpoint 1 — December 31, 2026 (Strip-Down & Portal Verification)**
- Non-essential items moved to storage, sold, or donated; living space reduced to bare essentials.
- Transparency Portal live with baseline room photos, inventory liquidation log, and $[redacted] balance ledger verified by the Owner.

**Checkpoint 2 — January 31, 2027 (Tax Filing & Housing Shortlist)**
- Tax return prepared and submitted as soon as IRS e-file opens.
- Top 2–3 housing options (5th wheel, mobile home, land, or rental/purchase) researched, priced, and vetted against expected refund down payment.
- Secondary clear-out and packing completed.

**Checkpoint 3 — February 28, 2027 (Debt Settlement & Move-In Lock)**
- Tax refund received (or IRS deposit date confirmed); full balance repaid to the Owner (or scheduled upon deposit).
- Down payment / purchase / lease finalized for next residence; utility shutoff and transfer dates locked in.

**Final Hard Stop — March 31, 2027 (Exit & Handover)**
- Complete physical move-out finished; final cleaning and walkthrough completed.
- Keys handed over on or before March 31, 2027. All financial obligations concluded.

*(Accountability Clause: If documented progress is not posted on the Transparency Portal by any checkpoint date, you retain the right to terminate Option B early and require an immediate exit.)*

---

## Baseline Alternative: Option A — Hard Exit (December 31, 2026)

If your preference is to end all housing arrangements by year-end regardless of our tax refund timing:

- We will vacate the property on or before **December 31, 2026**, moving belongings into storage and arranging temporary accommodations until our tax refund arrives.
- Your support ends completely on December 31, 2026. Because a rapid December move requires all available cash on hand, the **$[redacted]** will be paid in full as soon as our tax refund deposits in **late February / early March** (or via **$[redacted] installments** starting February 1 if any delay occurs).

---

## Agreement & Path Selection

Please check the selected option below so we can lock the schedule into the Transparency Portal:

- [ ] **Option A:** Hard Exit on December 31, 2026 ($[redacted] settled via Feb/Mar tax refund)
- [ ] **Option B:** Phased Checkpoint Exit through March 31, 2027 (Full balance + Q1 bridge settled via Feb/Mar tax refund)
